Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

We are pleased to announce that we are finally ready to unveil the details of Marvel Future Fight 2.2.0. Read the notes below for more information. 

 

▣ New Character

 

 Super Hero “Hyperion” joins the fight for the future! A native of Earth-13034, this super powered Eternal is the last of his race. Absorbing cosmic radiation as the source of his powers, this Eternal has gone toe to toe with some of Marvel’s strongest characters.

 

 

* Hyperion Biometrics are only available in the “Get 20 Biometrics Daily” package.

 

New Team Bonuses and Achievement have been added for Hyperion.

 

 * Skill description is based on Lv.1.

 

 ▣ 2 New 6★ Skills

 

 Yondu and Ronan will get their 6★ Skills.

 

 

 

 

 - Yondu(including uniform): Ravager Strike.

- Yondu’s Previous 5★ skill “Ravager Strike” will be improved, and changed to be his 6★ skill.

- New 5★ Skill “Yaka Arrows” has been added.

 - Ronan(including uniform): Judgement Call.

 

 

 

▣ 6 New Uniforms

 

 New Uniforms have been added for Ronan, Yondu, Malekith, Iron Fist, Mockingbird, and Black Widow.

 

* New Uniforms will be on sale during the sales period.

* You will be available to check more details and changes in Marvel Universe and Uniform room.

 

▣ 7 New Tier-2 Advancement

 

-      7 Characters are now able to advance their powers and become Tier-2 Characters! Check out the following Characters who will be able to advance in 2.2.0.

 

[Advancement?]
   A character which is Advanced from Tier-1 to Tier-2 will gain a stat increase, as well as a new passive skill.

  * Level, Mastery, and Gear Upgrade will not change after the Advancement.

 

▣ UI Changes

A newly designed UI has been added to Marvel Future Fight. The fight is going universal, as we prepare to navigate the known universe.

 

 

 

▣ New Features in Gear Upgrade.

 

 1. Max Upgrade & Auto Enhance

 

  Based on your character’s current level and materials in your inventory, you can upgrade to the limit that your character’s gear can get.

 

- Max Upgrade: Gears can be upgraded to +15 automatically.

- Auto Enhance: After +15, your gears will enhance one level at a time. (Material consumption may vary).

   * Upgrading gears using crystals will only increase your gear level by one.

 

 

 

2. Gear Option Auto Change

 Gear options now can be changed automatically based on your selection.

 

 

 

▣ Daily Mission Changes

 

The old style of Daily missions have returned, with some all new levels. Slay everything on your path take out the boss. Number of Entries and energy needed have changed, and the rewards received have been improved.

 

 

 * Stage 6 of the Daily Missions will be opened automatically for everybody, even if you have yet to complete the other stages.

 

 1. Daily Entry and Energy Cost Changes

 

Now it requires less play time to complete daily missions, as you can only enter twice per day. But fear not, we have greatly improved the rewards and drop rates of the Daily Missions. The Energy cost of the missions is now 10 Energy per entrance.

  * Entry limits and energy will only be consumed once the mission has finished.

  * If you fail to finish the mission, energy and Entrance limits will not be consumed.

 

 

 

 2. Bonus Rewards

  A new set of bonus rewards have been added. By completing the daily mission 6 times, you will be able to open a bonus chest containing extra items.

  * Once you receive the rewards, the Bonus Item reward bar will start to increase again.

 

 

 

 

▣ Special Mission Changes

 

1.     Entry Limit Changes

To obtain more rewards and consume less time, Special Mission’s have been modified so that the drop rates have improved, however you will only be able to enter twice.

* No matter how many stars you receive after completing the special stage, you will always be able to activate the no limit mode after 2 clears.

 

  2. Special Mission Progress and No Limit changes

   After this update, progress and no limit mode will be combined based on Story lines. This means that completing one mission in the “Guardians of The Galaxy” storyline will increase the No-Limit meter for all missions in the “Guardians of The Galaxy” Storyline. 

 

 

 * You can enter any chapter in the story to fill and use the no-limit bar.

 * Your available entrances and No-Limit progress will reset after the patch. So we strongly suggest use your No-Limit chances before the update arrives.

 

 3. New Difficulty

  6th Stage has been added for each chapter.

 

 

 

 4. Level 60 Special Missions will have shifters if the other stages had them.

   The following levels with have shifters

- Big Ideas #6: Giant-Man

   - Amazingly Interesting Voyage #6: Ant-Man, Wasp

   - Growth Spurt #6: Ant-Man, Wasp, Vision

 

 5. Special Gears

- Special Gears will be dropped in Special Missions.

- You will be able to obtain 1~3★ Special Gear in special missions.

 

▣ Villain Siege Changes

 

 1. Stage changes based on difficulties

  Villain Siege stage has been separated based on difficulties.

  * Total amount of rewards will remain the same. 

 

 

 

2. Recommended Hero Reward Changes

 Based on stage number reducation, Recommended Hero Rewards have also been modified.

 

 

 

 

▣ Battleworld changes

 

 1. Real-Time Battleworld

   You will once again be able to face your foes in real time. The ‘Real-Time Battleworld: Duel’ has been added.

※     Battleworld: Duel is still in its Beta testing period. During this period you may face unstable network connections. We will also be working on this mode more, so other changes are possible.

※     When the mode is ready for its official release from beta, we will let you know!

 

 

 

You will also be able to chat with the opponent during the battle!

 

 

 

2. Differences in Real-Time Battleworld and Normal Battleworld.

These 2 Battleworlds will not share their Entries.

In Live Battleworld, you will not be able to reroll your opponent, but you will be matched with someone who is within your range.

 

▣ Dimension Rift Changes

 

1. Alliance member can join your Dimension Rifts

 - Not only your friends, but your alliance members can also enter your Dimension Rifts.

  * If a rift is opened, and one of your alliance members leave in that time, they will still be able to access your dimension rift.

 

2.     Dimension Rift Energy Consumption Changes

For your convenience, Dimension Rifts have had their Energy Consumption costs reduced.

  - Stage#1: 6 → 4

  - Stage#2: 8 → 6

  - Stage#3: 10 → 8

  - Stage#4: 12 → 10

  - Stage#5: 14 → 12

 

▣ Inventory Changes

 

  Sell All button for ISO-8, Special Gear, and Comic Cards has been added.

 

 

 

▣ Special Gear Changes

 

  1. Changing Option

 

   If an Obelisk is maxed out, you will use a maxed Obelisk to change the option.

 

2. Special Gear Rank Modification

 

 Instead Numbers, Special Gears now have ★s to show their rank.

 *If there are no ★s, you will not be able to upgrade that gear. However it can be use it as upgrade material for other gears.

 

  * You will be able to change the options with an obelisk that is the same rank.

 

 

 

 3. Fixed Option

 

The first option in a special gear is now fixed, and will not change when a gear is upgraded.

However, the stat number can increase until the stat hits maximum limit for gears.

 

 

 

▣ Comic Card Changes

 

  1. Easy upgrade

     In the result screen, you can directly move to the card list.

 

   - OK: Move to Comic Card List.

 - Detailed Info: You will be able to check the detailed information of the cards.

   - Upgrade/Combine: You will be able to Upgrade or Combine the currently selected card.

 

 

 

 2. Filtering

  Filtering has been added to filter the cards based on their rank. (Normal ~ Mythical).

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Other Changes

 

1. Mission achievement for Journey of Growth #26, #34, #49 quest has been modified.

 - [Daily Mission] Clear Stage 5 times → Clear Stage 1 time.

2. Mission achievement for Journey of Growth#36, #52, #60 quest has been modified.

  - Journey of Growth #36 : Enter Villain Siege 3 times → 1 time.

  - Journey of Growth #52 : Success Villain Siege 2 times → 1 time.

  - Journey of Growth #60 : Success Villain Siege 3 times → 1 time.

3. Norn Stone rewards for Hero’s Journey will give you the right Norn Stone based on the selection of your character.

4. Rewards from Guide Quest(Hero’s Journey / Journey of Growth) will be directly sent to your Inventory.

   * Selector and Chests will be sent to your mail.

5. Journey List has been added for Guide Quest (Hero’s Journey / Journey of Growth).

- You will be able to check the mission achievement, rewards, and tutorial in Journey List.

6. Shortcut has been added for Guide Quest (Hero’s Journey / Journey of Growth).

- You will be directly moved to the mission that you need to complete to continue your quest.

7. Tutorial has been added for Guide Quest (Hero’s Journey / Journey of Growth).

- You will be able to check the tutorial related to the current quest.

8. Hero’s Journey has been changed.

- You will be able to obtain similar level of rewards compare to Journey of Growth. Also the difficulty has been reduced

  * Selectable Characters have stayed the same.

9. Challenges Changes.

- [Daily] ISO-8 Enhancement x1 (Reward: Gold X 7000) → Enter Special Mission x1 (Reward: Energy X 20).

- [Daily] Participate Timeline Battle x5 →  x1.

- [Weekly] ISO-8 Combine x3 (Reward: Gold x30000)→ Special Mission Stage Clear x25 (Reward: Energy x40).

- [Weekly] Daily Mission x15 (Reward: Energy x35) → x5 (Reward: Energy x40).

  - [Weekly] Story Mission Stage Clear x50 (Reward: Energy x30) → (Reward: Energy x35).

  - [Weekly] Participate Timeline Battle x50 (Reward: Energy x35) → (Reward: Energy x40).

  - [Weekly] Win Timeline Battle x10 (Reward: Gold x35000) → (Reward: Gold x50000).

  - [Weekly] ISO-8 Enhancement x10 (Reward: Gold x30000) → (Reward: Gold x45000).

  - [Weekly] Participate Villain Siege x7 → x5.

10. Some Alliance achievement changes.

  - [Daily] Daily Mission Stage Clear x60 → x30.

  - [Daily] Villain Siege Stage Clear x90 → x30.

  - [Weekly] Daily Mission Stage Clear x600 → x200.

  - [Weekly] Villain Siege Stage Clear x900 → x200.

11. All Characters will have their Best Condition reset when the Server resets.

12. Assemble Points will reset when the Server resets.

13. AI attack pattern in Timeline Battle will now have more variation.  

14. The countdown before a Timeline Battle starts will be changed from 5 seconds to 2 seconds.

15. Sale Item List of Chaotic Token Shop will be change.

  - Black Panther Biometrics will not be purchasable after the update.

   "Chaos Custom Gear Chest" will be added.

Move Out

Move In

Biometrics: Black Panther

Chaos Custom Gear Chest

16. Token Shop Chest can now be purchased in multiples (x5 and x10 only)

 

17. If your account is not strong enough to attempt the World Bosses(3x 6★ Character), the mission will be locked.

18. Fixed an issue with World Boss Mission menu where it would start at a stage that was not opened.

19. Add a new feature called “View Mode”. This can hide menus and buttons in Missions when they are run on Autoplay.

   

20. Fixed an issue with Carnage’s Symbiote strains from “Camouflage Strike” where it could give debuffs to team mates.

21. Fixed an issue with Green Goblin(Ultimate)’s Skill “Fiery Quake” not have a skill effect.

22. Corvus Glaive will now have Ebony Maw as a striker.

23. Fixed an issue with Ebony Maw’s Striker list where he had another Ebony Maw.

24. Yondu’s Leadership Skill has been changed and a new Ability added.

- Leadership Skill: Remove the condition “Activates when: Speed type team member joins” and it now applies to “All team members”.

- New Ability added: Weapon Master.

25. Ebony Maw’s Ability has been changed from “Mind” to “Pure Evil”.

26. You will be able to check the Hero Information in all of the biometric selectors.

   * Include “Get 20 Biometrics Daily”.

27. Biometrics / Hero Selector now has selection rate.

- Rate will be determined based on the last 7 days of selection from all users.

- Each Biometrics / Heroes will be ordered based on the rate of selection.

- Include “Get 20 Biometrics Daily”, Hero’s Journey, and First fail rewards.

28. Filter has been added for Biometrics / Hero Selector.

- You can filtered by All / Owned / Combat / Blast / Speed / Universal.

29. Due to Villain Siege changes, VIP reward has been changed as well.

- VIP 13: Additional Chaotic Token from 20 to 60.

- VIP 14: Additional Chaotic Token from 30 to 90.

  - VIP 15: Additional Chaotic Token from 50 to 150.


30. World Boss Issue with has been fixed. 

 - Fixed an issue with World bosses interactions with illusions and I-Frames affecting overall difficulty of the stage.  

 - Fixed an issue with the attack pattern of Thanos where he was not using skills as intended.
